title: Fix offline summary length/rendering and ensure quiz renders up to 10 questions

requirements.summary: Make offline summaries substantially longer and ensure the dashboard displays the full returned summary with preserved formatting (no truncation).
acceptanceCriteria: When uploading a non-trivial PDF/TXT/MD file with substantial text, the displayed summary contains substantially more content than the current output (i.e., not just a very short excerpt).
Summary rendering preserves line breaks/paragraphs and does not truncate or collapse content in the UI (the full summary string returned by processing is visible).
Offline mode (no webhook URL configured) produces a longer summary than before for the same input file.

file_operations.description: Improve offline summary generation to be noticeably longer and more informative by using paragraph/sentence-aware extraction, higher length targets (more characters/sections), and better handling of single-line PDFs so summaries are not overly short in offline mode.

Ensure the summary UI renders the entire summary string without any visual truncation and preserves line breaks/paragraphs (e.g., render in a block element with whitespace-preserving wrapping and safe long-word breaking). Use existing shadcn-ui Card styling already in place; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Verify summary state is passed through unchanged and that the Summary section does not apply any limiting container styles; adjust layout only as needed to keep the full returned summary visible on the dashboard.

requirements.summary: Fix offline quiz generation/data handling so the Interactive Quiz shows up to 10 questions when sufficient source text exists and renders all returned items with correct counts.
acceptanceCriteria: In offline mode, when the uploaded document has sufficient content, the returned quiz_array contains 10 items and the UI displays “Quiz (10 questions)”.
The quiz UI renders all items in quizArray (no slicing/hidden limiting), and the question numbering runs from 1 to the full length of quizArray.
If fewer than 10 questions are available due to insufficient source content, the UI still renders all returned questions and the displayed count matches quizArray.length.

file_operations.description: Adjust offline quiz generation to reliably produce up to 10 questions when content is sufficient (e.g., add robust fallback question generation from headings/keywords/sentences and only return fewer when the source text is genuinely too small), ensuring quiz_array length aligns with the available content.

Ensure the displayed quiz count always reflects quizArray.length and confirm no UI logic limits the rendered list. Continue using existing shadcn-ui Card/Button components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Confirm the quiz renderer maps over the full quizArray without slicing/limiting and that numbering always runs 1..quizArray.length; adjust only if any hidden limiting behavior is discovered.
